metadata.description: Standards bypass configuration for this branch

bypass.reason: FPLAN-0561 row 1 (2026-09-12) - the published in-process door for @api's /v1/machine route (row 2), the screen_lock pattern. Its consumer lives in src/aipass/api, outside this per-branch scan, which states it cannot see cross-branch callers. Pinned by tests/test_machine_vitals.py (45 cases). Remove if a branch-local caller lands (text actions as renderings of the dict, a later row). machine_processes (DPLAN-0414 T3, 2026-10-16) is the same door's sibling: its only caller is @api's handlers/host/machine_route.py (/v1/machine/processes), pinned by the same test file.

list is the one verb that takes no arguments: a no-args gate would print introspection in place of `drone @skills list`, the branch's main verb. The module's introspection is reached by `list --help` (pinned in tests/test_discovery.py). Remove if the entry point ever passes list a filter argument.

notes.usage: Add entries to 'bypass' list to exclude specific violations
